title: Rosemary Beach "Mr. Sanders" 122 West Kingston Road -Carriage House
h1: Rosemary Beach "Mr. Sanders" 122 West Kingston Road -Carriage House
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Located North of 30A- Close proximity to neighborhood parks and community pools- Carriage house- 3 adult bikes- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforters, laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Enjoy a charming Rosemary Beach getaway at Mr. Sanders Carriage House, a delightful 1-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home with versatile sleeping arrangements that accommodates up to 10 guests, making it a perfect retreat for families or groups looking to explore Iconic 30A! Located in a quiet setting, guests can enjoy a peaceful escape while still within walking distance of local shops, the community’s multiple pools, and the beach—only a short 6-minute stroll away!Welcoming and bright, this 3-level home cheerfully opens onto a beautiful sitting area. After a day on the beach, recline on the sofa and 2 saucer chairs to relax with a laughter-filled movie night in the air conditioning. A queen sleeper sofa and 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds offer sleeping accommodations on this level.Ascend the classic spiral staircase to the second floor, which hosts the fully equipped modern kitchen, sunlit 4-seat dining table, and a comfy sofa and TV. Gleaming hardwood floors, a beamed ceiling, and double-set doors with a lunette window incorporate the area’s colonial style. Outside, the covered balcony beckons guests to savor a fragrant cup of coffee in the coastal breeze each morning. For restful nights, the guest bedroom features a king bed and private bathroom.The top-level loft is a great option for children with 2 twin beds resting beneath a vaulted ceiling. A mounted TV in the corner provides entertainment, and there’s a half bath for convenience.With the beach a quick walk away and access to all of Rosemary Beach’s amenities, Mr. Sanders Carriage House promises a fun, convenient seaside escape. Parking for 2 vehicles and 3 complimentary adult bikes makes it easy to explore all the attractions and neighborhoods of 30A. For the nearest beach access, follow Kingston Road and West Water Street to Walkover I. Book today and start planning a refreshing coastal vacation!SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10):CARRIAGE HOUSE:FIRST FLOOR: -Other sleeping arrangement: Two Twin Over Twin Bunks and Queen Sleeper Sofa, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower OnlyTHIRD FLOOR:-Lofted Area: Two Twin BedsIn addition, you also have access to these fantastic Rosemary Beach amenities:- Coquina Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.- Sky Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 6 am to 10 pm (Adult Only Hours, 6 am-9 am & 8 pm-10 pm)- Cabana Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.- Barbados Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm.Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.*Your rental property may share a courtyard or lot with a carriage house or main house that is owner-occupied or rented to separate guests from your party. Unfortunately, the private pool is for the main house only

body_text_excerpt: Destinations Travel Collections Experiences + Services About Us Homeowners Travel Blog View Gallery Rosemary Beach "Mr. Sanders" 122 West Kingston Road -Carriage House Inlet Beach, FL Short Term Rental #STR-222670 Bedrooms 1 Beds 8 Sleeps 10 Full Baths 2 Half Baths 1 HOME HIGHLIGHTS: - Located North of 30A - Close proximity to neighborhood parks and community pools - Carriage house - 3 adult bikes - Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforters, laundered upon every checkout DETAILS: Enjoy a charming Rosemary Beach getaway at Mr. Sanders Carriage House, a delightful 1-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom home with versatile sleeping arrangements that accommodates up to 10 guests, making it a perfect retreat for families or groups looking to explore Iconic 30A! Located in a quiet setting, guests can enjoy a peaceful escape while still within walking distance of local shops, the community’s multiple pools, and the beach—only a short 6-minute stroll away! Welcoming and bright, this 3-level home cheerfully opens onto a beautiful sitting area. After a day on the beach, recline on the sofa and 2 saucer chairs to relax with a laughter-filled movie night in the air conditioning. A queen sleeper sofa and 2 twin-over-twin bunk beds offer sleeping accommodations on this level. Ascend the classic spiral staircase to the second floor, which hosts the fully equipped modern kitchen, sunlit 4-seat dining table, and a comfy sofa and TV. Gleaming hardwood floors, a beamed ceiling, and double-set doors with a lunette window incorporate the area’s colonial style. Outside, the covered balcony beckons guests to savor a fragrant cup of coffee in the coastal breeze each morning. For restful nights, the guest bedroom features a king bed and private bathroom. The top-level loft is a great option for children with 2 twin beds resting beneath a vaulted ceiling. A mounted TV in the corner provides entertainment, and there’s a half bath for convenience. With the beach a quick walk away and access to all of Rosemary Beach’s amenities, Mr. Sanders Carriage House promises a fun, convenient seaside escape. Parking for 2 vehicles and 3 complimentary adult bikes makes it easy to explore all the attractions and neighborhoods of 30A. For the nearest beach access, follow Kingston Road and West Water Street to Walkover I. Book today and start planning a refreshing coastal vacation! SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (Sleeps 10): CARRIAGE HOUSE: FIRST FLOOR: -Other sleeping arrangement: Two Twin Over Twin Bunks and Queen Sleeper Sofa, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo SECOND FLOOR: -Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only THIRD FLOOR: -Lofted Area: Two Twin Beds In addition, you also have access to these fantastic Rosemary Beach amenities: - Coquina Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm. - Sky Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 6 am to 10 pm (Adult Only Hours, 6 am-9 am & 8 pm-10 pm) - Cabana Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm. - Barbados Pool: open daily to residents and guests from 9 am to 9 pm. Weddings are not allowed at this home.
